title: The cubic graph relation between Speyer and Tutte polynomials
statement:
Let $G$ be a connected cubic graph with $n$ vertices. Write the Tutte polynomial as

$$
\mathsf{T}_G(x,y)=\sum_{i,j}t_{i,j}(G)x^iy^j.
$$

**Cubic Tutte relation conjecture.** The second derivative of Speyer's polynomial satisfies

$$
g_G”(0)=2n\,t_{0,1}(G)-4t_{0,2}(G).
$$

This would give a uniform relation between a coefficient of Speyer's polynomial and the first two relevant Tutte coefficients for connected cubic graphs. The paper reports data supporting the identity but does not prove it.
source_name: Erik Panzer, “Graph theoretic properties of Speyer's matroid polynomial g_M(t)”, arXiv:2506.18788 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18788

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2025).
